name: Mutsugoku Koi Iroha
source:
The story is that the protagonist is a first year that attends “Mutsugoku Academy”, hidden deep in the mountains. She holds a deep secret… she doesn’t know what ‘supernatural entity’ she is. You see, only supernatural entities attend this academy. The heroine is in search to understand the power within her…

[from [url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2023/11/09/monthly-overview-josei-muke-game-releases-november-2023/]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述的是，主人公是隐藏在大山深处的“陆奥学园”的一年级学生。她隐藏着一个深深的秘密……她不知道自己是什么‘超自然实体’。你看，只有超自然实体才能进入这所学院。女主角正在寻找了解她内心的力量……

[来自[url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2023/11/09/monthly-overview-josei-muke-game-releases-november-2023/]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
